text: A boathouse loft at first light seen from the hatch. The very broad anthro badger stands at the bench with his back to us. He has a white stripe from brow to nape and one short thick tail. He wears a collarless linen shirt with the sleeves pushed past the elbow under a rust-brown leather apron, barefoot. A brass lantern with a trimmed wick sits on the near end of the bench in front of him. The window over the far end is bright and the near end stays dim.

locks: collarless linen shirt with the sleeves pushed past the elbow
permanent_features: white stripe from brow to nape
